summary: This Audio class is a comprehensive Page Object Model for HP audio control UI testing on Windows. It inherits from HPXRebrandingFlow and provides extensive methods for verifying and interacting with audio settings including: input/output device selection, volume controls, EQ sliders, audio presets (music/movie/voice/RPG/shooter/strategy), AI noise removal/reduction, mic modes, speaker configurations, DTS sound settings, MEP (Microsoft Effects Platform) integration, multistreaming, adaptive audio, and external speaker settings. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for UI automation with WinAppDriver for Windows desktop applications. It includes screenshot comparison decorators for visual regression testing across different text sizes, colors, and system modes. Methods follow a consistent naming pattern with verify_* for element visibility checks, click_* for interactions, get_* for retrieving values, and set_* for adjusting controls. The class handles dynamic scrolling, conditional element waiting, and device-specific variations (willie_robotics, gidget, arti, thompson, london, divinity, snowball, quardo platforms). It also integrates with Windows system settings, task scheduler for app installation, and SSH utilities for remote operations.
